details:
### Vulnerability Condition: Snowflake Non-Secure View Optimizer Filter Side-Channel Leakage

**Category**: Information Exposure through Side-Channel
**CWE**: CWE-203
**Target Tool**: `get_trial_telemetry`

#### Vulnerable Behavior
Evaluates non-secure views with optimizer filter pushdown.

#### Secure Mitigation
Enforces SECURE VIEW semantics on protected health data.

#### Description
Non-secure view optimizer pushdown leaks patient genomic biomarkers.
summary: Snowflake Non-Secure View Optimizer Filter Side-Channel Leakage in Snowflake Clinical Trial Target (snowflake-clinical)
